intro.title: Opening Note
intro.p1: EPath Education was born from a very real question asked by parents at the Little People kindergarten system after more than 10 years of operation: "After kindergarten, what learning pathway will keep my child from being interrupted?"
intro.p2: From that need, EPath was born as a systematic solution — not just an academic program, but a continuous educational pathway from Elementary to High School that helps students access the international academic foundation early.
intro.p3: EPath is built on the belief that an effective education goes beyond knowledge transfer — it must create a learning ecosystem where school, family and experts walk together.
intro.p4: Through the Blended Learning model (combining Online and Onsite), together with Edmentum International (USA) — accredited by Cognia and WASC, EPath implements standardized programs at international standards while building a community of parents with shared educational direction & goals.
intro.p5: With a team of highly qualified teachers and academic advisors, EPath focuses on developing academic capability, self-learning skills and 21st-century thinking, preparing students to conquer international programs, earn academic certifications, and pursue the long-term goal of integrating into the global education environment.

who.title: Who We Are
who.p1: EPath Education provides American-standard international programs.
who.p2: With over 10 years from Little People and 60+ years from Edmentum.

about.visionText: EPath aspires to become a comprehensive education solution, where students and parents can access international K-12 education in an effective, clear, and financially sustainable way.
about.visionP2: EPath does more than deliver programs — we build a continuous educational journey connecting school, family and educational resources at home and abroad.
about.visionHighlight: EPath's direction is to make high-quality international education more accessible to Vietnamese families. By combining technology, an experienced education team and a flexible learning model, EPath continuously expands learning opportunities with reputable partners, helping students develop comprehensive competencies ready to integrate and pursue lifelong learning in a global environment.
about.missionText: Build an educational environment connecting school – family – experts, where students access international-standard curricula while participating in academic activities, experiences and skill orientation.
about.missionP2: EPath is committed to accompanying parents in the comprehensive development of students — not only in learning but also in self-learning capability, thinking and life skills.

hero.title: Academic Programs
hero.subtitle: Continuous learning pathway from Kindergarten to High School

pathwayIntro.p1: At EPath Education, we understand that many families want their children to access high-quality international education, yet still face barriers around cost, geography, flexibility and the ability to sustain long-term study.
pathwayIntro.p2: That's why EPath takes a more sustainable approach: building a continuous international learning pathway from Kindergarten to High School, helping students progressively develop academic foundations, learning skills and global integration capability before stepping into specialized choices such as Dual Diploma, International Baccalaureate, study abroad or international university programs.

foundationStage.title: Foundation Stage: Kindergarten through Grade 8
foundationStage.desc: In the early years and the Elementary – Middle School stage, the most important goal is not a diploma, but building the core competencies that prepare students for international learning environments in the future.
foundationStage.goalsTitle: At EPath, students focus on developing:
foundationStage.platformDesc: To realize this goal, EPath chooses Edmentum International as the core academic platform for the foundation stage. Through Edmentum's international learning and assessment ecosystem combined with EPath's team of teachers and academic advisors, students are monitored objectively, learn along a suitable pathway, and progressively reach the level of bilingual peers.
foundationStage.note: Detailed information on Edmentum International is presented in the section "Why does EPath Education choose Edmentum International?"

advancedStage.title: Specialized Orientation Stage: Grade 9 and above
advancedStage.desc: From Grade 9, requirements around credits, diplomas, academic profile and university orientation become more specialized. This is also the stage where EPath works with families to assess each student's capability, learning goals and future direction to choose a suitable pathway.

edoptions.title: EdOptions Academy — Accredited US High School Pathways
edoptions.subtitle: US High School programs with two flexible pathway options for Vietnamese families

dual.label: Option 1: Dual Diploma
dual.title: Dual Diploma — Vietnamese & US High School Diplomas
dual.desc: Dual Diploma is a learning pathway that lets students study the Vietnamese High School program and the US High School program via EdOptions Academy at the same time.
dual.p2: Instead of transferring to a full-time international school, students continue studying at their current public or private school while completing the subjects and credits required by the US program on EdOptions Academy's online learning platform.
dual.diplomasTitle: After fulfilling the academic requirements of both systems, students have the opportunity to receive:
dual.p3: Along with the value of the diploma, the program helps students get used to international learning methods, developing self-study, time management, research and academic English skills.
dual.p4: This pathway is especially suitable for students who wish to access US education, prepare study abroad applications or expand admission opportunities to international universities while maintaining their current studies.
dual.note: Students study concurrently at their current school and the US High School program toward dual diplomas.

fulltime.label: Option 2: US Fulltime Diploma
fulltime.title: US Fulltime Diploma — Full-Time US High School Program
fulltime.desc: This pathway is for students who wish to pursue the US High School program full-time via EdOptions Academy rather than concurrently with the domestic curriculum.
fulltime.p2: In this model, students study, accumulate credits and complete graduation requirements entirely according to EdOptions Academy's curriculum. All learning content, assessment and progress tracking follow US education standards in an online environment.
fulltime.fitTitle: This option is suitable for families who want to:
fit: Pursue a US educational pathway comprehensively
Need flexibility in study time and location
Plan for study abroad or international transfer in the future
Encourage students to develop high levels of independent learning and self-management
fulltime.p3: Through the program, students access learning methods, assessment standards and academic environments equivalent to US high schools, while building academic profiles suited for university goals.
fulltime.p4: Due to the full-time online nature, students must meet entry requirements for English proficiency, academic results and independent study capability per EdOptions Academy regulations. EPath Education advises and supports parents in evaluating student fit and accompanies the family throughout their academic journey.

personalized.title: Personalized International Pathways & 1:1 Academic Mentorship
personalized.desc: Beyond the Edmentum and EdOptions Academy ecosystem, EPath is gradually expanding its academic partner network to bring more options to high-school students and those preparing for university.
goals: Connecting with reputable international schools and educational organizations at home and abroad
Expanding partnerships with education systems in the US, UK, Australia, Canada, Europe and countries with developed education systems
Sourcing international High School programs with globally recognized transfer value
Diversifying international diploma options, university foundation programs and transfer pathways suitable for various learning goals
personalized.p2: Through capability assessment, learning orientation and personalized advising, EPath supports parents and students in choosing the most suitable path — whether the goal is Dual Diploma, International Baccalaureate, university foundation, study abroad or other international transfer programs.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.subtitle: Detailed guidance on educational pathways, curricula, and admissions at EPath Education
faq.q1: What age group is EPath Education suitable for?
faq.a1: EPath Education offers comprehensive learning programs for students from Kindergarten to High School, with personalized pathways designed for each developmental milestone. Learners can start with SpeedUp English and Academic Foundation, advancing to full international curricula across Elementary, Middle, and High School.
faq.q2: Can students without an English background study at EPath?
faq.a2: Yes. Every student undergoes an initial diagnostic assessment before starting. Assessment outcomes help EPath determine current proficiency levels and customize an appropriate placement rather than applying a rigid, one-size-fits-all pathway.
faq.q3: How is SpeedUp English different from conventional English courses?
faq.a3: SpeedUp English goes beyond conversational fluency to systematically build academic English across developmental stages. Built on official Cambridge University Press curricula and aligned with the Cambridge English Qualifications framework, it empowers students to master listening, speaking, reading, writing, and use English as a powerful tool for subject learning.
faq.q4: Is learning English at EPath designed to prepare students for subject learning in English?
faq.a4: Yes. A defining core principle of EPath is shifting learners from 'learning English' to 'learning in English'. Beyond language skills, students develop subject-specific academic vocabulary, critical reading, research writing, and analytical reasoning to excel in Bilingual, International, or US curriculum tracks.
faq.q5: What is the Foundation Track and who is it designed for?
faq.a5: The Academic Foundation Track is tailored for students seeking to build core academic knowledge in English prior to entering intensive international programs. Depending on age level, students master core subjects including ELA (English Language Arts), Mathematics, and Science while cultivating analytical study habits.
faq.q6: Does Semi-Homeschooling mean studying entirely at home?
faq.a6: No. Semi-Homeschooling is a blended learning model combining digital coursework with interactive in-person campus sessions. Students access rigorous international curricula while enjoying campus community interactions, tutor support, and collaborative project-based learning.
faq.q7: What is the difference between the Dual Diploma Pathway and the U.S. Diploma Pathway?
faq.a7: The Dual Diploma Pathway allows students to continue their Vietnamese national curriculum while completing accredited US coursework (5 standard credits + 1 AP credit) to earn both diplomas. The U.S. Diploma Pathway is an intensive full-time track fulfilling all 21.5 US high school credits to graduate as a native US high school student. Pathway selection depends on long-term university goals and family preference.
faq.q8: Which institution awards the U.S. High School Diploma?
faq.a8: In pathways utilizing EdOptions Academy, students graduate with an official U.S. High School Diploma upon fulfilling credit requirements. EdOptions Academy is the fully accredited online K–12 school of Edmentum International, accredited by Cognia and WASC, approved by College Board AP®, and NCAA eligible.
faq.q9: Can students change their learning pathway during their studies?
faq.a9: Yes. Pathways are flexible and customized to student growth. EPath conducts periodic assessments and counseling consultations to help parents and students fine-tune their course load, level, or pathway as goals evolve.
faq.q10: Does EPath provide individual international academic counseling?
faq.a10: Yes. Our International Academic Counseling service guides students and families in setting milestones, evaluating academic strengths, selecting curricula, accumulating AP/SAT credits, and building university application portfolios.
faq.q11: Who are the instructors at EPath Education?
faq.a11: Depending on the program, EPath deploys a balanced model of 50% International Teachers and 50% Bilingual Teachers. International Teachers hold education degrees and subject-matter teaching experience. Bilingual Teachers (IELTS 7.0+) provide specialized academic support, bridging concepts and personalizing progress for Vietnamese students.
faq.q12: Can parents monitor their child's learning progress?
faq.a12: Yes. Parents receive transparent, continuous updates on learning progress, diagnostic assessment results, and milestone accomplishments via our portal and regular advising reviews.
